headline: Incoming Press Secretary Resigns After Realizing 'Reconsider' Was Just The Name Of The Office Espresso Machine
body: The newly appointed press secretary tendered her resignation moments after the President’s directive to 'go reconsider' turned out to be a command to fix the malfunctioning 'Reconsider' branded coffee maker in the briefing room. Administration sources confirm she had spent two hours drafting an entire foreign policy pivot before realizing the Chief Executive just wanted a double-shot latte.
caption: When the boss's feedback is actually just a request for caffeine. A classic case of internal communications gone wrong. #WhiteHouse #OfficeLife #MistakenIdentity #CoffeeBreak (satire)
igHook: Have you ever completely misinterpreted a boss's request like this?
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of a modern, stainless steel coffee machine sitting on a cluttered wooden side table in a dimly lit, nondescript government office hallway.

sourceHeadline.title: New White House Press Chief Fired Hours After Trump Asked Her To "Reconsider"
